subject: Handoff: Observability onboarding cadence, dashboards & runbook binder
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <epark@cloudmore.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T17:02:00Z
Subject: Handoff: Observability onboarding cadence, dashboards & runbook binder

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I’m starting the formal handoff to our CS/implementation track so we can move into an actionable onboarding cadence for dashboards, tracing hooks, error taxonomy, alert routing and the runbook binder.

Proposed high-level plan:
- Week 0 (this week): alignment call to confirm data feeds, SLO targets, and primary contacts.
- Week 1: tagging & tracing hook implementation (sample code + verification).
- Week 2: dashboard delivery (errors, latency P95, tail latency), and alert routing matrix.
- Week 3: runbook draft and first-run playbook validation in staging.

Can you confirm: 1) the primary BrightGate engineering contact for instrumentation (name + email), and 2) any non-standard retention/SOC requirements we should bake into dashboards or runbooks?

I’ve attached our onboarding templates to speed ramp-up (onboarding-templates.zip).

Next step: I suggest a 60-minute kickoff Wednesday Nov 24 10:00am PT — does that work for your team?

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: onboarding-templates.zip (archive, 2.1MB)
From: Elena Park <epark@cloudmore.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@brightgate.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T19:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Handoff: Observability onboarding cadence, dashboards & runbook binder

Sergio —

Thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers:
- Primary instrumentation lead is Tom Li (tom.li@brightgate.com) — he’s cc’d.
- Retention: logs retained 90 days; traces retained 30 days in our staging environment. For production we can extend to 365 days but would need a cost add.
- SLOs: we’ll target 99.9% availability for API traffic and 95th/99th latency targets (Tom will share baseline numbers).

Wednesday 11/24 10am PT works for us. I attached our existing alert matrix so you can see what we currently route to paging and to the Slack ops channel.

—Elena
Elena Park
Director, CloudOps
CloudMore (BrightGate trial)

--
Attachment: current-alert-matrix.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

Thanks — looping in the implementation squad and proposed owners below. I’ll own the overall delivery and checkpoints.

Proposed owners and deliverables:
- Instrumentation & tracing hooks (owner: Tom Li from BrightGate, assisted by Ben Carter) — deliver: sample hooks, verification script, test events.
- Dashboards & alerts (owner: Ben Carter) — deliver: Ops dashboard, Errors dashboard, Alert routing matrix, runbook links.
- Runbook binder (owner: Laura Bennett) — deliver: runbook-binder-v1.docx, escalation matrix, postmortem template.
- Post-deploy validation & SLO sign-off (owner: Monica Patel) — deliver: validation checklist & handoff ticket.

I’ve created a 4-week sprint with twice-weekly check-ins for the first two weeks and weekly thereafter. Proposed kickoff: Wed 2026-11-24 10:00 PT (60m). Please confirm and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Action items for the kickoff (please come prepared):
- BrightGate: baseline latency/SLO numbers + example trace ID for a failed request.
- Redwood: initial dashboard wireframes and alert severity mapping.
- Both: Slack channel for incident routing (we recommend #brightgate-ops-redwood).

I uploaded a draft runbook binder and a shared folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-onboarding-binder — use that for all artifacts and versioned runbooks.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Program Manager, Implementation
Redwood Inference
